The assortment contains both natural and polished stones, including a labeled Labradorite specimen. All pieces are in good condition with no visible damage, and the lot features a range of sizes and shapes.

278072320.description: This is a vintage handmade African tribal percussion instrument, specifically a rattle or shaker. It features a double-triangle or hourglass-shaped wooden frame constructed from natural branches. Several metal discs or washers are attached with natural wire, producing sound when shaken. The frame is decorated with raw quartz crystals affixed by wire. The instrument measures approximately 15 inches in height. It shows signs of use and age, including wear on the wood and metal parts, contributing to its rustic and authentic appearance. This item can be used as a functional musical instrument or as a unique decorative or collectible piece. Please review all photos carefully, as they are considered part of the item description. Vintage and collectible items may show wear, discoloration, scratches, crazing, repairs, age-related deterioration, or other imperfections consistent with age and use. Due to the nature of donated goods, we cannot guarantee age, rarity, authenticity, manufacturer attribution, production dates, or collectible value unless specifically stated in the listing. Please ask any questions prior to bidding.
